purpose: Defines the immutable release payload (every file SHA256SUMS.txt must list and that must keep its SHA-256) and the runtime output that legitimately appears beside it. Used by tools/release-integrity.cjs (Node tests) and windows/M31-Integrity.ps1 (Windows test runner); both read this file only after its own SHA-256 has been verified against SHA256SUMS.txt.
payload: Every file under the application folder, except the runtime output folders, development metadata folders and operating-system metadata files listed here.
runtimeOutputNote: test-results is the only folder inside the application folder where test runners may write. Milestone 3.1 runners write to %LOCALAPPDATA%\EightMax-Test-Workbench\TestResults by default; test-results holds output of older runners or a location the operator chose. Nothing in the release runs files from it.

knownRuntimeExecutables.description: Desktop host compiled from the shipped sources by the host-start test (fallback compile cache of an older runner or of a run written to test-results). Recognised only when compiler-output.sha256 in the same folder equals the file's SHA-256.
